## Comprehensive Architectural Analysis of Tutors Reader (D:\code\tutors)

Version 15.2.0 -- SvelteKit 2 + Svelte 5 educational platform.

---

### 1. ROUTE STRUCTURE

The app uses SvelteKit's route groups (parenthesized directories) to separate concerns. All content routes disable SSR (`export const ssr = false`), making this a fully client-side SPA.

**Layout Groups:**

| Group | Layout file | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `(auth)` | None (uses root) | Authentication flows |
| `(course-reader)` | `+layout.svelte` | All course content viewing; wraps children in `TutorsShell`, tracks navigation, fires analytics, scrolls to top |
| `(home)` | `+layout.svelte` | Landing page; resets `currentCourse` to null, wraps in `TutorsShell` |
| `(live)` | `+layout.svelte` | Live activity and catalogue; resets `currentCourse`, fetches catalogue counts from Supabase |

**Root layout:** `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\+layout.svelte` -- imports `app.css`, reconnects auth, initializes theme.
**Root server layout:** `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\+layout.server.ts` -- extracts session/user from `locals.auth()`.

**Complete route listing:**

| Route | Params | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/` (home) | none | Landing page with welcome text, course visit list, links |
| `/auth` | none | GitHub sign-in (no course redirect) |
| `/auth/[courseid]` | `courseid` | GitHub sign-in with post-auth redirect to that course |
| `/course/[courseid]` | `courseid` | Course home -- renders `Composite` view of the full course |
| `/topic/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `courseid`, `loid` (rest) | Topic detail -- renders `Composite` view of a topic |
| `/lab/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `courseid`, `loid` (rest) | Lab viewer -- multi-step markdown lab or PDF fallback |
| `/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `courseid`, `loid` (rest) | Talk viewer -- PDF presentation (Adobe or Mozilla) |
| `/note/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `courseid`, `loid` (rest) | Note viewer -- rendered markdown |
| `/video/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `courseid`, `loid` (rest) | Video viewer -- iframe embed (YouTube/HEAnet/Vimp) |
| `/tutorial/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `courseid`, `loid` (rest) | Tutorial viewer -- note + optional PDF (via `TalkClient`) |
| `/paneltalk/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `courseid`, `loid` (rest) | Panel talk viewer -- PDF presentation in context |
| `/wall/[type]/[courseid]` | `type`, `courseid` | Wall view -- lists all LOs of a given type for a course |
| `/search/[courseid]` | `courseid` | Full-text search across labs, steps, notes, panelnotes |
| `/time/[courseid]` | `courseid` | Student analytics -- calendar heatmaps and lab-by-step tables |
| `/llm/[courseid]` | `courseid` | LLM docs page -- links to llms.txt and PDF archives per topic |
| `/catalogue` | none | Platform-wide course catalogue from Supabase |
| `/live` | none | Real-time activity dashboard (courses/students/groups via PartyKit) |
| `/live/[courseid]` | `courseid` | Course-specific live activity with day/week/month/year tabs |

**Patterns observed:**
- Every course-reader route uses the `[courseid]` param and most use `[...loid]` (rest param) for nested LO paths.
- All page data loaders (`+page.ts`) go through `courseService` to load/cache the course, then look up the specific LO.
- Consistent `Context`/`Composite` wrapping pattern for content pages.

---

### 2. CONTENT TYPES (Learning Object Types)

**Canonical type registrations from `@tutors/tutors-model-lib`:**

`simpleTypes` (file `D:\code\tutors\node_modules\@tutors\tutors-model-lib\src\types\type-utils.js`, line 10):
`note`, `archive`, `web`, `github`, `panelnote`, `paneltalk`, `panelvideo`, `podcast`, `talk`, `book`, `lab`, `tutorial`

`loCompositeTypes` (same file, line 27):
`unit`, `side`, `topic`, `course`

**Type-to-route coverage matrix:**

| Type | Has Route | Has Icon | Has Content Renderer | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `course` | `/course/[courseid]` | Yes (all icon libs) | `Composite.svelte` | Top-level container |
| `topic` | `/topic/[courseid]/[...loid]` | Yes | `Composite.svelte` | |
| `unit` | No dedicated route | Yes | Rendered inside `Units.svelte` | Composite, shown inline in topics |
| `side` | No dedicated route | Yes | Rendered inside `Units.svelte` | Sidebar variant of unit |
| `lab` | `/lab/[courseid]/[...loid]` | Yes | `Lab.svelte` | Multi-step markdown with nav |
| `talk` | `/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]` | Yes | `TalkClient.svelte` -> `TalkAdobe`/`TalkMozilla` | PDF presentations |
| `note` | `/note/[courseid]/[...loid]` | Yes | `Note.svelte` | Rendered markdown |
| `tutorial` | `/tutorial/[courseid]/[...loid]` | Yes | `Note.svelte` + optional `TalkClient` | Text + optional PDF |
| `paneltalk` | `/paneltalk/[courseid]/[...loid]` | Yes | `TalkClient.svelte` | Panel-embedded presentation |
| `panelvideo` | No dedicated route | Yes | `Video.svelte` (inline in panels) | Displayed inside `Panels.svelte` |
| `panelnote` | No dedicated route | Yes (fluent, hero, easter, festive, valentine) | `Note.svelte` (inline in panels) | Rendered in `Panels.svelte` |
| `video` | `/video/[courseid]/[...loid]` | Yes (`video` icon) | `Video.svelte` | iframe embed |
| `podcast` | No dedicated route | Yes | `Podcast.svelte` (inline in panels, Wall) | Spotify embed |
| `web` | No dedicated route | Yes | Card link only (opens in new tab) | External URL |
| `github` | No dedicated route | Yes | Card link only | GitHub repo link |
| `archive` | No dedicated route | Yes | Direct download link | `archiveFile` URL |
| `book` | No dedicated route, no icon | **NO icon registration** | Handled as lab first step marker | Used only in `readLab` path detection |

**Partial support issues identified:**
1. **`book`** -- registered as a `simpleType` but has NO icon in any icon library and no route. It is only used as a path detection hint in `courseService.readLab()` (line 96: `if (!lastSegment.startsWith("book"))`).
2. **`reference`** -- has icon registrations (all icon libs) but is NOT in the `simpleTypes` or `loCompositeTypes` arrays. It appears only as an icon key, never as an actual LO type. This is orphaned icon configuration.
3. **`podcast`** -- no dedicated route. Rendered only via `Panels.svelte` inline or through the wall (`/wall/podcast/[courseid]`). The wall view in `Wall.svelte` has explicit podcast rendering logic.
4. **`tutorial`** -- registered as a simple type, has a route and icon. However, the route at `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\(course-reader)\tutorial\[courseid]\[...loid]\+page.svelte` line 14 reuses `Note.svelte` rather than a dedicated Tutorial component. Its model type (`Tutorial`) in the model lib extends `Lo` with a `pdf` field, which the route does handle via conditional `TalkClient`.
5. **`panelvideo`**, **`panelnote`** -- no dedicated routes; rendered inline through `Panels.svelte`. They use the wall view when accessed via `/wall/video/[courseid]` or `/wall/note/[courseid]`.

**Icon libraries:**
- `FluentIconLib` at `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\themes\icons\fluent-icons.ts` -- primary default, used by most themes
- `HeroIconLib` at `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\themes\icons\hero-icons.ts` -- alternative, same keys but different icon sets
- `EasterIcons` at `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\themes\icons\easter-icons.ts`
- `FestiveIcons` at `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\themes\icons\festive-icons.ts`
- `HalloweenIconLib` at `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\themes\icons\halloween-icons.ts` -- **defined but NOT used** in any theme. The `themeService.themes` array (line 23-33 of `themes.svelte.ts`) does not include a "halloween" theme.
- `ValentineIcons` at `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\themes\icons\valentine-icons.ts` -- **defined but NOT used** in any theme configuration.

**Unused icon libraries:** `HalloweenIconLib` and `ValentineIcons` are defined but never referenced from `themeService.themes`. They are orphaned.

**HeroIconLib** is only referenced in `themeService.addIcon()` (line 175), which pushes custom icons into it. However, no theme in the themes array actually uses `HeroIconLib`. It is only referenced programmatically.

### 3. SERVICE LAYER

Five service modules under `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\`:

#### 3a. Course Service (`services/course/`)
- **Entry:** `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\course\index.ts`
- **Singleton:** `courseService` (plain object implementing `CourseService`)
- **State:** Three `Map` caches (`courses`, `labs`, `notes`) plus reactive `courseUrl` rune
- **Public API:**
  - `getOrLoadCourse(courseId, fetch)` -- fetches `tutors.json` from Netlify, caches, decorates tree
  - `readCourse(courseId, fetch)` -- loads course, sets global `currentCourse`/`currentLo`
  - `readTopic(courseId, topicId, fetch)` -- navigates to topic in course tree
  - `readLab(courseId, labId, fetch)` -- creates/retrieves `LiveLab` instance
  - `readWall(courseId, type, fetch)` -- retrieves all LOs of given type
  - `readLo(courseId, loId, fetch)` -- loads specific LO, processes notes
  - `refreshAllLabs(codeTheme)` -- re-renders all cached labs when code theme changes
- **Supporting class:** `LiveLab` (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\course\services\live-lab.ts`) -- manages lab step navigation, markdown-to-HTML conversion, keyboard nav arrows
- **Tree utilities:** `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\course\services\lo-tree.ts` -- `decorateCourseTree()`, `determineCourseUrl()`, `injectCourseUrl()`. Handles breadcrumbs, panels, units, icons, wall construction, calendar init.

#### 3b. Connect Service (`services/connect/`)
- **Entry:** `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\connect\index.ts`
- **Singleton:** `tutorsConnectService` (plain object implementing `TutorsConnectService`)
- **Public API:**
  - `connect(redirect)` / `disconnect(redirect)` -- GitHub OAuth sign-in/out
  - `reconnect(user)` -- restores session, switches to Supabase profile, handles login redirect
  - `toggleShare()` -- toggles presence sharing on/off
  - `updateSentiment(sentiment)` -- persists mood to localStorage + Supabase
  - `courseVisit(course)` -- records visit, starts presence, handles whitelist/auth redirect
  - `favouriteCourse(id)` / `unfavouriteCourse(id)` / `deleteCourseVisit(id)` / `getCourseVisits()`
  - `learningEvent(params)` -- records analytics + broadcasts presence
  - `startTimer()` / `stopTimer()` -- 30-second analytics interval
  - `checkWhiteList()` -- enrollment whitelist enforcement
- **Profile implementations:**
  - `localStorageProfile` (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\connect\services\localStorageProfile.ts`) -- anonymous/default, persists visit history in `localStorage.courseVisits`
  - `supabaseProfile` (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\connect\services\supabaseProfile.svelte.ts`) -- authenticated, persists in `tutors-connect-profiles` table

#### 3c. Community Service (`services/community/`)
- **Entry:** `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\index.ts`
- **Four singletons:**
  1. `catalogueService` -- queries `tutors-connect-courses` table for course catalogue, prunes invalid entries
  2. `liveService` -- PartyKit WebSocket for platform-wide real-time presence (courses online, students online), uses Svelte runes for reactive state
  3. `presenceService` -- PartyKit WebSocket for course-specific real-time presence, broadcasts LO events, upserts to `tutors-connect-latest`
  4. `analyticsService` -- records page loads and duration tracking to `learning_records` and `calendar` tables in Supabase

#### 3d. Markdown Service (`services/markdown/`)
- **Entry:** `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\markdown\index.ts`
- **Singleton:** `markdownService`
- **Supports:** 30 programming languages for syntax highlighting via Shiki (JS, TS, Python, Java, Kotlin, C#, C, C++, Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Swift, Haskell, Scala, R, etc.)
- **Themes:** 7 code themes (ayu-dark, monokai, github-dark, night-owl, solarized-light, github-light, catppuccin-latte)
- **Public API:**
  - `setCodeTheme(theme)` -- changes and persists code highlighting theme
  - `convertLabToHtml(course, lab, refreshOnly)` -- processes all lab steps
  - `convertNoteToHtml(course, note, refreshOnly)` -- processes note content

#### 3e. Themes Service (`services/themes/`)
- **Entry:** `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\themes\index.ts`
- **Singleton:** `themeService`
- **7 registered themes:** tutors, classic, dyslexia, terminus, rose, cerberus, easter

| `LoReference` | Single LO link with icon, used in tree/breadcrumb displays |

#### Learning Object Layout (`src/lib/ui/learning-objects/layout/`)
| Component | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Card` | Universal card component supporting portrait/landscape/circular styles. Renders student cards separately. |
| `Cards` | Renders a grid of Card components, handles hidden LO pin-unlock |
| `Units` | Renders units with headers and nested cards |
| `Panels` | Renders inline panel content (podcasts, videos, talks, notes) |
| `Wall` | Full-page wall view with special handling for video and podcast types |
| `LoContextPanel` | Side panel showing topic context with image and tree |

#### Content Renderers (`src/lib/ui/learning-objects/content/`)
| Component | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Lab` | Multi-step lab with sidebar navigation, keyboard arrow keys, horizontal mobile nav |
| `Note` | Rendered markdown content with KaTeX support |
| `TalkClient` | PDF viewer router -- dispatches to Adobe or Mozilla PDF renderers based on course config |
| `TalkAdobe` | Adobe PDF Embed API viewer with configurable orientation |
| `TalkMozilla` | pdfjs-dist canvas-based PDF viewer with navigation, rotate, download, fullscreen |
| `Video` | iframe video embed supporting YouTube, HEAnet, and Vimp services |
| `Podcast` | Spotify embed iframe for podcast episodes |
| `Calendar` | Table view of course calendar weeks with current week highlight |

#### Generic Components (`src/lib/ui/components/`)
| Component | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Icon` | Icon wrapper using @iconify/svelte with Skeleton Tooltip |
| `IconBar` | Row of icons from an `IconNavBar` config |
| `Image` | Image component with optional mini mode |
| `Menu` | Skeleton Popover-based menu |
| `MenuItem` | Menu item (exists but appears unused in current code) |
| `Sidebar` | Dialog-based sliding sidebar (left or right) |
| `NotFound` | 404 page placeholder |
| `SetuIcon` | SETU university logo (hardcoded URL) |
| `TutorsIcon` | Tutors logo SVG |

#### Time/Analytics Components (`src/lib/ui/time/`)
| Component | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Catalogue` | Grid of course cards from catalogue |
| `Course` / `Courses` / `CourseGroup` / `CoursesGroup` / `CourseGroupHeader` | Live activity groupings |
| `Students` / `StudentCard` | Student presence cards with avatar, activity, sentiment |
| `ConnectLatestLosCards` | Cards for latest student activity per time period |

**Potentially unused components:**
- `MenuItem` at `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\ui\components\MenuItem.svelte` -- no imports found in any other file
- `HalloweenIconLib` and `ValentineIcons` -- defined but never assigned to a theme
- `HeroIconLib` -- only referenced in `addIcon()`, never used as a theme's icon set

---

### 5. EXTERNAL DEPENDENCIES AND INTEGRATIONS

**Environment variables** (from `D:\code\tutors\.env.example`):

| Variable | Purpose | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| `PUBLIC_ANON_MODE` | Disables all auth/analytics when "TRUE" | Public |
| `PRIVATE_AUTH_GITHUB_ID` | GitHub OAuth App client ID | Private/server |
| `PRIVATE_AUTH_GITHUB_SECRET` | GitHub OAuth App client secret | Private/server |
| `PRIVATE_AUTH_SECRET` | Auth.js secret for JWT signing | Private/server |
| `PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` | Supabase project URL | Public |
| `PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` | Supabase anonymous API key | Public |
| `PUBLIC_party_kit_main_room` | PartyKit WebSocket server URL | Public |
| `PUBLIC_PDF_KEY` | Adobe PDF Embed API client ID | Public |

**External services:**

1. **GitHub OAuth** -- via `@auth/sveltekit` + `@auth/core/providers/github`. Configured in `D:\code\tutors\src\hooks.server.ts`. JWT-based sessions with 1-year expiry. Extracts GitHub `login` into session.

2. **Supabase** -- via `@supabase/supabase-js`. Client created in `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\utils\supabase-client.ts`. Supabase tables used:
   - `tutors-connect-courses` -- course catalogue (visit counts, course metadata)
   - `tutors-connect-profiles` -- user course visit history/favorites
   - `tutors-connect-users` -- student records (avatar, name, email, sentiment, online_status)
   - `tutors-connect-latest` -- latest LO interaction per student per course
   - `learning_records` -- per-LO interaction tracking (duration, count, type)
   - `calendar` -- per-day time-active and page-load tracking
   - Supabase RPCs: `get_count_learning_records`, `increment_calendar`

3. **PartyKit** (via `partysocket`) -- WebSocket-based real-time presence. Two rooms:
   - `tutors-all-course-access` -- global platform-wide activity
   - `[courseId]` -- per-course student activity

4. **Adobe PDF Embed API** -- loaded dynamically from `acrobatservices.adobe.com/view-sdk/viewer.js`. Requires `PUBLIC_PDF_KEY`.

5. **pdfjs-dist** -- Mozilla PDF.js for alternative PDF rendering. Worker loaded from `/pdf.worker.min.mjs` (static asset).

6. **Spotify** -- Podcast embeds via `https://open.spotify.com/embed/episode/{episodeId}`.

7. **GitHub API** -- Called in `addOrUpdateStudent()` at `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\utils\supabase-client.ts` line 358 to fetch user display name if missing.

8. **KaTeX** -- CSS loaded from CDN (`cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.8`) in Lab and Note components for LaTeX math rendering.

9. **tsParticles** -- Snow animation for festive theme. Loaded globally (expects `tsParticles` and `loadSnowPreset` on `globalThis`).

10. **Netlify** -- Courses are hosted as static sites on Netlify subdomains (`{courseId}.netlify.app/tutors.json`).

11. **@tutors/tutors-time-lib** -- External library for student time analytics. Initialized in `hooks.client.ts` with Supabase credentials.

---

### 6. STATE MANAGEMENT

**Primary pattern: Svelte 5 runes via a custom `rune<T>()` factory.**

File: `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\runes.svelte.ts`

The `rune()` function creates a getter/setter wrapper around `$state()`:

```typescript
export const rune = <T>(initialValue: T) => {
  let _rune = $state(initialValue);
  return {
    get value() { return _rune; },
    set value(v: T) { _rune = v; }
  };
};
```

**Global state containers:**

| Rune | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `currentCourse` | `Course \| null` | Currently loaded course |
| `currentLo` | `Lo \| null` | Currently viewed learning object |
| `tutorsId` | `TutorsId \| null` | Authenticated user identity |
| `currentLabStepIndex` | `number` | Active lab step index |
| `adobeLoaded` | `boolean` | Whether Adobe SDK script is loaded |
| `animationDelay` | `number` (200) | Animation timing |
| `courseProtocol` | `string` ("https://") | Protocol for course URLs (http for localhost) |
| `hideMainNavigator` | `boolean` | Hides top nav for immersive views (labs, notes) |

**Service-level reactive state (using `rune()`):**
- `courseService.courseUrl` -- current course URL
- `liveService.listeningForCourse`, `.coursesOnline`, `.studentsOnline` -- live dashboard state
- `presenceService.studentsOnline` -- current course online students
- `themeService.layout`, `.cardStyle`, `.lightMode`, `.currentTheme` -- visual preferences
- `currentCodeTheme` -- markdown code highlighting theme

**Additional state patterns:**
- `$state()` and `$derived()` used directly in Svelte 5 components
- `$effect()` for reactive side effects (analytics, data loading)
- `LoRecord` class (`D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\community\types.svelte.ts`) uses `$state()` for reactive properties
- `localStorage` used extensively for persistence (theme, layout, cardStyle, codeTheme, modeCurrent, share, courseVisits, tutorsTimeId, loginCourse, sentiment)

**No Svelte stores (`writable`/`readable`) are used** -- the codebase has fully migrated to Svelte 5 runes.

---

### 7. TESTING

**There is NO test infrastructure whatsoever.**

- Zero `.test.*` files found
- Zero `.spec.*` files found
- No test runner in `package.json` scripts (no `vitest`, `jest`, `playwright`, etc.)
- No test configuration files
- No test dependencies in `package.json`
- No `.github/workflows/` CI pipeline for tests
- The `svelte.config.js` suppresses the `state_referenced_locally` warning globally (line 11-13)

The only quality tooling present:
- `svelte-check` for type checking
- `eslint` + `prettier` for linting and formatting
- `eslint-plugin-svelte` for Svelte-specific linting

---

### 8. BUILD AND DEPLOY

**Package.json scripts** (`D:\code\tutors\package.json`):

| Script | Command | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `dev` | `vite dev` | Development server |
| `build` | `vite build` | Production build |
| `preview` | `vite preview` | Preview production build |
| `prepare` | `svelte-kit sync \|\| echo ''` | SvelteKit codegen |
| `check` | `svelte-kit sync && svelte-check` | TypeScript checking |
| `check:watch` | Same with `--watch` | Continuous type checking |
| `format` | `prettier --write .` | Auto-format |
| `lint` | `prettier --check . && eslint .` | Lint check |

**Vite config** (`D:\code\tutors\vite.config.ts`):
- Uses `@sveltejs/kit/vite` plugin and `@tailwindcss/vite` plugin
- Defines `APP_VERSION` from `package.json` version
- No code splitting configuration, chunking, or bundle optimization

**Svelte config** (`D:\code\tutors\svelte.config.js`):
- Uses `@sveltejs/adapter-auto` (auto-detects deployment platform)
- `@sveltejs/adapter-netlify` is a dependency but not directly configured (adapter-auto will select it when deployed to Netlify)
- `vitePreprocess()` for preprocessing

**No Netlify-specific config files** (no `netlify.toml`). The adapter handles this automatically.

**CI/CD:**
- `D:\code\tutors\.github\CODEOWNERS` -- code ownership file
- `D:\code\tutors\.github\holopin.yml` -- Holopin badge configuration
- No GitHub Actions workflow files found
- No CI pipeline for builds, tests, or deployments

**Deployment model:** Likely continuous deployment via Netlify's GitHub integration (push-to-deploy), using adapter-auto/adapter-netlify.

---

### 9. ACCESSIBILITY

**Current a11y coverage is minimal and inconsistent:**

**What exists:**
- `aria-hidden="true"` on breadcrumb separators (`Breadcrumbs.svelte`, lines 31, 36, 42) and lab navigation arrows (`live-lab.ts`, lines 76, 88) -- correct usage
- `aria-label` on calendar heatmap SVGs (`CalendarHeatmap.svelte`, lines 88, 95)
- `aria-label` on the sentiment button (`CourseSentimentButton.svelte`, line 28) and a video iframe (line 47)
- `role="img"` on heatmap SVGs
- Most images have `alt` attributes, though several use empty `alt=""` (cards with no meaningful alt text -- `Card.svelte` lines 75, 96)
- `title` attribute used on iframes for video/podcast embeds

**Gaps and issues:**
1. **No skip-to-content link** -- the `TutorsShell` has no way to bypass the navigation bar.
2. **No focus management** -- after route navigation, focus is not programmatically moved. The `afterNavigate` in the course-reader layout only scrolls, does not manage focus.
3. **Keyboard navigation is limited** -- Labs support arrow keys for step navigation, and the `Cards.svelte` has a keypress handler for the "ignore pin" feature, but there is no general keyboard navigation support.
4. **Empty alt attributes** -- Several images use `alt=""` where meaningful descriptions should be present (card figures at `Card.svelte` lines 75, 96).
5. **`a11y_no_static_element_interactions`** -- The Breadcrumbs component has a Svelte-ignore for this warning (line 48), meaning a `<span>` has mouse event handlers without proper ARIA role.
6. **Raw `{@html}` rendering** -- Lab content, notes, and summaries are rendered with `{@html}`, which bypasses any semantic structure guarantees. Lab navigation HTML is string-concatenated with no ARIA roles.
7. **Color contrast** -- No explicit contrast checking. Theme colors are defined via CSS variables, but there is no documented contrast ratio validation.
8. **No ARIA landmarks** -- The `TutorsShell` uses `<header>`, `<main>`, and `<footer>` semantic elements (good), but no `<nav>` or ARIA landmark roles on the breadcrumbs/sidebar navigation.
9. **No screen reader announcements** -- Route changes produce no live region announcements.
10. **The search input** (`search/+page.svelte`) has a proper `<label>` element but uses a button-triggered search rather than live search, which is acceptable.

---

### 10. PERFORMANCE

**Positive patterns:**

1. **Course caching** -- `courseService` caches loaded courses, labs, and notes in `Map` instances, avoiding redundant fetches.
2. **Lazy PDF rendering** -- `TalkClient.svelte` dynamically imports `TalkMozilla.svelte` using `{#await import(...)}` (line 17), implementing component-level code splitting.
3. **SSR disabled** -- All routes use `export const ssr = false`, which means no server rendering overhead, but also no initial HTML for SEO.
4. **Lab markdown conversion is deferred** -- Notes and labs are only converted to HTML when actually visited (on-demand in `readLab`/`readLo`), not when the course tree is loaded.
5. **Shiki highlighter** -- Uses `createHighlighterCoreSync` with the JavaScript regex engine and specific language/theme imports rather than loading all languages.
6. **Video component** uses `setTimeout` delay (500ms) before rendering, preventing premature iframe loading.
7. **Podcast embeds** use `loading="lazy"` on iframes (`Podcast.svelte`, line 24).

**Potential concerns:**

1. **Large bundle risk: Shiki** -- 30 programming languages and 7 themes are imported at module level in `markdown.svelte.ts`. Even with tree-shaking, this is a significant payload. All languages load regardless of whether the course uses them.

2. **Large bundle risk: pdfjs-dist** -- `pdfjs-dist` is imported at the top level of `TalkMozilla.svelte`. While the component itself is dynamically imported, the PDF.js core is still a substantial dependency.

3. **No route-level code splitting beyond SvelteKit defaults** -- SvelteKit handles per-route splitting automatically, but the shared service layer (especially markdown with Shiki) loads eagerly.

4. **PartyKit WebSocket connections** -- `liveService` creates a global WebSocket connection on module load if `PUBLIC_party_kit_main_room !== "XXX"` (line 17 of `live.svelte.ts`). This means every page load establishes a WebSocket even if the live feature is not being used.

5. **Analytics timer** -- A 30-second `setInterval` runs continuously in the course-reader layout (`startTimer()` called in the layout's `<script>`). It checks `document.hidden` but does not pause the interval.

6. **No image optimization** -- Course images are loaded directly from course URLs with no srcset, lazy loading, or next-gen format optimization.

7. **`flattenLos` on every course load** -- `decorateCourseTree()` in `lo-tree.ts` flattens the entire course tree on load, then iterates multiple times to set up indexes, breadcrumbs, and conversions. For large courses this could be expensive.

8. **String-based HTML rendering** -- Lab navigation is built via string concatenation (`live-lab.ts`), not components. This bypasses Svelte's virtual DOM diffing.

9. **No service worker or offline support** -- No PWA configuration.

10. **External CDN dependencies loaded at runtime:**
    - Adobe PDF SDK (`acrobatservices.adobe.com`)
    - KaTeX CSS (`cdn.jsdelivr.net`)
    - tsParticles (for festive theme)
    - Iconify icons (loaded on demand from CDN by `@iconify/svelte`)

---

### Summary of Key Findings

**Architecture strengths:**
- Clean separation of concerns via SvelteKit route groups and service modules
- Consistent pattern for loading and rendering learning objects
- Effective caching strategy in courseService
- Full Svelte 5 runes adoption (no legacy stores)
- Comprehensive icon theming system with multiple seasonal variants
- Dual profile storage (localStorage fallback for anonymous, Supabase for authenticated)

**Architecture risks/gaps:**
- Zero test coverage -- no tests of any kind
- No CI/CD pipeline
- Orphaned code: `HalloweenIconLib`, `ValentineIcons`, `HeroIconLib` (defined but unused in themes), `MenuItem.svelte`, `book` type (no icon/route)
- `reference` icon key exists in all icon libraries but is not a registered LO type
- Minimal accessibility implementation
- Shiki bundle size with 30 languages loaded eagerly
- Global WebSocket connection regardless of feature usage
- No image optimization or lazy loading strategy for course content

---

## Comprehensive Architectural Analysis of Tutors Reader (D:\code\tutors)

Version 15.2.0 -- SvelteKit 2 + Svelte 5 educational platform.

---

### 1. ROUTE STRUCTURE

The app uses SvelteKit's route groups (parenthesized directories) to separate concerns. All content routes disable SSR (`export const ssr = false`), making this a fully client-side SPA.

**Layout Groups:**

| Group | Layout file | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `(auth)` | None (uses root) | Authentication flows |
| `(course-reader)` | `+layout.svelte` | All course content viewing; wraps children in `TutorsShell`, tracks navigation, fires analytics, scrolls to top |
| `(home)` | `+layout.svelte` | Landing page; resets `currentCourse` to null, wraps in `TutorsShell` |
| `(live)` | `+layout.svelte` | Live activity and catalogue; resets `currentCourse`, fetches catalogue counts from Supabase |

**Root layout:** `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\+layout.svelte` -- imports `app.css`, reconnects auth, initializes theme.
**Root server layout:** `D:\code\tutors\src\routes\+layout.server.ts` -- extracts session/user from `locals.auth()`.

**Complete route listing:**

| Route | Params | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/` (home) | none | Landing page with welcome text, course visit list, links |
| `/auth` | none | GitHub sign-in (no course redirect) |
| `/auth/[courseid]` | `courseid` | GitHub sign-in with post-auth redirect to that course |
| `/course/[courseid]` | `courseid` | Course home -- renders `Composite` view of the full course |
| `/topic/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `courseid`, `loid` (rest) | Topic detail -- renders `Composite` view of a topic |
| `/lab/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `courseid`, `loid` (rest) | Lab viewer -- multi-step markdown lab or PDF fallback |
| `/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `courseid`, `loid` (rest) | Talk viewer -- PDF presentation (Adobe or Mozilla) |
| `/note/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `courseid`, `loid` (rest) | Note viewer -- rendered markdown |
| `/video/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `courseid`, `loid` (rest) | Video viewer -- iframe embed (YouTube/HEAnet/Vimp) |
| `/tutorial/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `courseid`, `loid` (rest) | Tutorial viewer -- note + optional PDF (via `TalkClient`) |
| `/paneltalk/[courseid]/[...loid]` | `courseid`, `loid` (rest) | Panel talk viewer -- PDF presentation in context |
| `/wall/[type]/[courseid]` | `type`, `courseid` | Wall view -- lists all LOs of a given type for a course |
| `/search/[courseid]` | `courseid` | Full-text search across labs, steps, notes, panelnotes |
| `/time/[courseid]` | `courseid` | Student analytics -- calendar heatmaps and lab-by-step tables |
| `/llm/[courseid]` | `courseid` | LLM docs page -- links to llms.txt and PDF archives per topic |
| `/catalogue` | none | Platform-wide course catalogue from Supabase |
| `/live` | none | Real-time activity dashboard (courses/students/groups via PartyKit) |
| `/live/[courseid]` | `courseid` | Course-specific live activity with day/week/month/year tabs |

**Patterns observed:**
- Every course-reader route uses the `[courseid]` param and most use `[...loid]` (rest param) for nested LO paths.
- All page data loaders (`+page.ts`) go through `courseService` to load/cache the course, then look up the specific LO.
- Consistent `Context`/`Composite` wrapping pattern for content pages.

---

### 2. CONTENT TYPES (Learning Object Types)

**Canonical type registrations from `@tutors/tutors-model-lib`:**

`simpleTypes` (file `D:\code\tutors\node_modules\@tutors\tutors-model-lib\src\types\type-utils.js`, line 10):
`note`, `archive`, `web`, `github`, `panelnote`, `paneltalk`, `panelvideo`, `podcast`, `talk`, `book`, `lab`, `tutorial`

`loCompositeTypes` (same file, line 27):
`unit`, `side`, `topic`, `course`

**Type-to-route coverage matrix:**

| Type | Has Route | Has Icon | Has Content Renderer | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `course` | `/course/[courseid]` | Yes (all icon libs) | `Composite.svelte` | Top-level container |
| `topic` | `/topic/[courseid]/[...loid]` | Yes | `Composite.svelte` | |
| `unit` | No dedicated route | Yes | Rendered inside `Units.svelte` | Composite, shown inline in topics |
| `side` | No dedicated route | Yes | Rendered inside `Units.svelte` | Sidebar variant of unit |
| `lab` | `/lab/[courseid]/[...loid]` | Yes | `Lab.svelte` | Multi-step markdown with nav |
| `talk` | `/talk/[courseid]/[...loid]` | Yes | `TalkClient.svelte` -> `TalkAdobe`/`TalkMozilla` | PDF presentations |
| `note` | `/note/[courseid]/[...loid]` | Yes | `Note.svelte` | Rendered markdown |
| `tutorial` | `/tutorial/[courseid]/[...loid]` | Yes | `Note.svelte` + optional `TalkClient` | Text + optional PDF |
| `paneltalk` | `/paneltalk/[courseid]/[...loid]` | Yes | `TalkClient.svelte` | Panel-embedded presentation |
| `panelvideo` | No dedicated route | Yes | `Video.svelte` (inline in panels) | Displayed inside `Panels.svelte` |
| `panelnote` | No dedicated route | Yes (fluent, hero, easter, festive, valentine) | `Note.svelte` (inline in panels) | Rendered in `Panels.svelte` |
| `video` | `/video/[courseid]/[...loid]` | Yes (`video` icon) | `Video.svelte` | iframe embed |
| `podcast` | No dedicated route | Yes | `Podcast.svelte` (inline in panels, Wall) | Spotify embed |
| `web` | No dedicated route | Yes | Card link only (opens in new tab) | External URL |
| `github` | No dedicated route | Yes | Card link only | GitHub repo link |
| `archive` | No dedicated route | Yes | Direct download link | `archiveFile` URL |
| `book` | No dedicated route, no icon | **NO icon registration** | Handled as lab first step marker | Used only in `readLab` path detection |

**Partial support issues identified:**
1. **`book`** -- registered as a `simpleType` but has NO icon in any icon library and no route. It is only used as a path detection hint in `courseService.readLab()` (line 96: `if (!lastSegment.startsWith("book"))`).
2. **`reference`** -- has icon registrations (all icon libs) but is NOT in the `simpleTypes` or `loCompositeTypes` arrays. It appears only as an icon key, never as an actual LO type. This is orphaned icon configuration.
3. **`podcast`** -- no dedicated route. Rendered only via `Panels.svelte` inline or through the wall (`/wall/podcast/[courseid]`). The wall view in `Wall.svelte` has explicit podcast rendering logic.
4. **`tutorial`** -- registered as a simple type, has a route and icon. However, the route reuses `Note.svelte` rather than a dedicated Tutorial component. Its model type extends `Lo` with a `pdf` field, which the route does handle via conditional `TalkClient`.
5. **`panelvideo`**, **`panelnote`** -- no dedicated routes; rendered inline through `Panels.svelte`. They use the wall view when accessed via `/wall/video/[courseid]` or `/wall/note/[courseid]`.

**Icon libraries:**
- `FluentIconLib` -- primary default, used by most themes
- `HeroIconLib` -- alternative, same keys but different icon sets
- `EasterIcons`, `FestiveIcons` -- seasonal themes
- `HalloweenIconLib` -- **defined but NOT used** in any theme
- `ValentineIcons` -- **defined but NOT used** in any theme configuration

**Unused icon libraries:** `HalloweenIconLib` and `ValentineIcons` are defined but never referenced from `themeService.themes`. `HeroIconLib` is only referenced programmatically in `addIcon()` but never assigned to any theme.

---

### 3. SERVICE LAYER

Five service modules under `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\services\`:

#### 3a. Course Service (`services/course/`)
- **Singleton:** `courseService` -- caches courses, labs, notes in Maps
- **Public API:** `getOrLoadCourse`, `readCourse`, `readTopic`, `readLab`, `readWall`, `readLo`, `refreshAllLabs`
- **Supporting class:** `LiveLab` -- manages lab step navigation, markdown-to-HTML, keyboard nav
- **Tree utilities:** `decorateCourseTree()`, `determineCourseUrl()` -- breadcrumbs, panels, units, icons, walls

#### 3b. Connect Service (`services/connect/`)
- **Singleton:** `tutorsConnectService` -- authentication, session management, analytics, presence
- **Public API:** `connect`/`disconnect`, `reconnect`, `toggleShare`, `updateSentiment`, `courseVisit`, `favouriteCourse`/`unfavouriteCourse`, `learningEvent`, `startTimer`/`stopTimer`, `checkWhiteList`
- **Two profile implementations:** `localStorageProfile` (anonymous) and `supabaseProfile` (authenticated)

#### 3c. Community Service (`services/community/`)
- **Four singletons:**
  1. `catalogueService` -- Supabase queries for course catalogue
  2. `liveService` -- PartyKit WebSocket for platform-wide real-time presence
  3. `presenceService` -- PartyKit WebSocket for course-specific presence
  4. `analyticsService` -- page load and duration tracking to Supabase

#### 3d. Markdown Service (`services/markdown/`)
- **Singleton:** `markdownService` -- Shiki highlighter with 30 languages, 7 code themes
- **Public API:** `setCodeTheme`, `convertLabToHtml`, `convertNoteToHtml`

#### 3e. Themes Service (`services/themes/`)
- **Singleton:** `themeService` -- 7 themes (tutors, classic, dyslexia, terminus, rose, cerberus, easter)
- **Public API:** `initDisplay`, `setDisplayMode`/`toggleDisplayMode`, `setTheme`, `setLayout`/`toggleLayout`, `setCardStyle`, `getIcon`/`addIcon`, `getTypeColour`, `eventTrigger`

---

### 4. COMPONENT INVENTORY

**59 Svelte components** organized in 4 groups:

- **Shell:** `TutorsShell.svelte` -- main app frame with header/main/footer
- **Navigators (16):** `MainNavigator`, `SecondaryNavigator`, `LayoutMenu`, `Breadcrumbs`, plus 10 button components and 2 profile components
- **Learning Object Structure (6):** `Composite`, `Context`, `CourseContext`, `LoContext`, `LoContextTree`, `LoReference`

File: `D:\code\tutors\src\lib\runes.svelte.ts`

The `rune()` function creates a getter/setter wrapper around `$state()`:

```typescript
export const rune = <T>(initialValue: T) => {
  let _rune = $state(initialValue);
  return {
    get value() { return _rune; },
    set value(v: T) { _rune = v; }
  };
};

### 10. PERFORMANCE

**Positive patterns:**

1. **Course caching** -- `courseService` caches loaded courses, labs, and notes in `Map` instances, avoiding redundant fetches.
2. **Lazy PDF rendering** -- `TalkClient.svelte` dynamically imports `TalkMozilla.svelte` using `{#await import(...)}` (line 17), implementing component-level code splitting.
3. **SSR disabled** -- All routes use `export const ssr = false`, which means no server rendering overhead, but also no initial HTML for SEO.
4. **Lab markdown conversion is deferred** -- Notes and labs are only converted to HTML when actually visited (on-demand in `readLab`/`readLo`), not when the course tree is loaded.
5. **Shiki highlighter** -- Uses `createHighlighterCoreSync` with the JavaScript regex engine and specific language/theme imports rather than loading all languages.
6. **Video component** uses `setTimeout` delay (500ms) before rendering, preventing premature iframe loading.
7. **Podcast embeds** use `loading="lazy"` on iframes (`Podcast.svelte`, line 24).

**Potential concerns:**

1. **Large bundle risk: Shiki** -- 30 programming languages and 7 themes are imported at module level in `markdown.svelte.ts`. Even with tree-shaking, this is a significant payload. All languages load regardless of whether the course uses them.

2. **Large bundle risk: pdfjs-dist** -- `pdfjs-dist` is imported at the top level of `TalkMozilla.svelte`. While the component itself is dynamically imported, the PDF.js core is still a substantial dependency.

3. **No route-level code splitting beyond SvelteKit defaults** -- SvelteKit handles per-route splitting automatically, but the shared service layer (especially markdown with Shiki) loads eagerly.

4. **PartyKit WebSocket connections** -- `liveService` creates a global WebSocket connection on module load if `PUBLIC_party_kit_main_room !== "XXX"` (line 17 of `live.svelte.ts`). This means every page load establishes a WebSocket even if the live feature is not being used.

5. **Analytics timer** -- A 30-second `setInterval` runs continuously in the course-reader layout (`startTimer()` called in the layout's `<script>`). It checks `document.hidden` but does not pause the interval.

6. **No image optimization** -- Course images are loaded directly from course URLs with no srcset, lazy loading, or next-gen format optimization.

7. **`flattenLos` on every course load** -- `decorateCourseTree()` in `lo-tree.ts` flattens the entire course tree on load, then iterates multiple times to set up indexes, breadcrumbs, and conversions. For large courses this could be expensive.

8. **String-based HTML rendering** -- Lab navigation is built via string concatenation (`live-lab.ts`), not components. This bypasses Svelte's virtual DOM diffing.

9. **No service worker or offline support** -- No PWA configuration.

10. **External CDN dependencies loaded at runtime:**
    - Adobe PDF SDK (`acrobatservices.adobe.com`)
    - KaTeX CSS (`cdn.jsdelivr.net`)
    - tsParticles (for festive theme)
    - Iconify icons (loaded on demand from CDN by `@iconify/svelte`)
